TextView.android:text:
This is pre-alpha version of Proton Calendar for Android for internal use only.

You can login with your PRODUCTION username and password (beta.protonmail.com). 2FA, nor 2-pass mode is not supported. After successful login you will be taken back to Calendar View. KILL THE APP, OPEN APP AGAIN. Then click (FETCH EVENTS) to get events that have start date between (TODAY) and (TODAY+1 WEEK).

You can click on events on the list and see event details or create events from main calendar view. If you create them outside of upcoming week, they will not appear on the list but you can check them on web.

Click (FETCH EVENTS) to refresh events after creating them or editing on web.

If at any point the application is unresponsive please go to Android settings, clear application storage/data, login again and fetch events.

Deleting events does not refresh local database (events are cached locally), check on web if it works.
